problem_statement: Meridian Edge is a marketing site for an edge delivery platform, built on this Nuxt 4 landing template (a home page with a hero, logo strip, feature grid, testimonials and a call to action; a /features page; and a /pricing page, all wrapped by a shared Navbar and Footer via the default layout). The /pricing page ships three plan tiers — Launch, Growth and Scale — with fixed monthly prices but no way to switch billing period, and there is no consistent plan summary shown on the other marketing pages. Enhance the site's OWN pricing feature with a Monthly / Yearly billing control and surface a matching plan summary across the site, keeping the light green-accent brand language. Specifically: (1) add a '.plan-billing' billing bar to the pricing section — a 'Billing' label, a Monthly / Yearly toggle and a '#billing-readout' line — and give each plan card a data-monthly and a data-yearly price so choosing Yearly swaps every card's price and cadence; (2) make the plan grid and the billing bar wrap so no page overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (tolerance 24px); (3) render the yearly layout as a clean, legible green-accent grid rather than overlapping, washed-out cards; (4) keep the '#billing-readout' in sync with the toggle so a visitor who selects Yearly sees 'Billed yearly …' and the yearly prices, read live from the current selection rather than a stale snapshot; and (5) add a shared 'Compare plans' footer band (a '.plan-strip' rendered once from the shared Footer) that recaps the three tiers on the home, features and pricing pages alike. Keep the rest of the site — navigation, hero, features and pricing content and the static build — intact with no console or network errors.
required_content: Add a Monthly / Yearly billing control (a '.plan-billing' bar with a 'Billing' label, a Monthly/Yearly toggle and a '#billing-readout' line) to the pricing section's own plan grid.
Give each plan card a monthly and a yearly price (data-monthly / data-yearly on the '.plan-price' node) so selecting Yearly swaps every card's price and its cadence to 'per year'.

Add a shared 'Compare plans' footer band (a '.plan-strip' recapping the Launch, Growth and Scale tiers) rendered once from the shared Footer so it appears on the home, features and pricing pages alike.
The plan grid and the billing bar must wrap responsively so no marketing page overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (overflow tolerance 24px).
Render the yearly plan grid as a clean, legible green-accent layout (no overlapping/shingled cards, no washed-out illegible prices, the POPULAR flag attached to its card).

Wire the billing toggle so that after selecting Yearly the '#billing-readout' names the yearly period (for example 'Billed yearly · save 20% …') and the card prices update, read live from the current selection rather than a stale captured snapshot.
Preserve the navigation, the hero, the features and pricing content, and the static Nuxt build with no console or network errors.
author_notes: Built on the netlify-templates nuxt-starter Nuxt 4 landing template (shared Navbar/Footer via layouts/default.vue, data-driven Hero/Features/Testimonials/Cta sections and a data-driven three-tier pricing grid, Tailwind green-accent palette). The rebrand to Meridian Edge, the pricing-section billing toggle and the shared 'Compare plans' footer band are rendered with the local hero and person image assets already in public/images; no remote assets are added. Design keywords: pricing billing toggle, plan grid, marketing continuity, edge delivery, brand palette, responsive layout, image assets.
design_constraints: Enhance the pricing page's OWN plan grid with the Monthly/Yearly billing control; do not bolt on a detached metric widget — the toggle and readout belong inside the pricing section.
The plan grid and billing bar must use a fluid, wrapping responsive layout (no fixed-width nowrap track) so they never force horizontal overflow on tablet or mobile.

The yearly view must keep the clean green-accent card grid — cards must not overlap or shingle with negative margins, prices and summaries must stay legible (no near-white-on-white), and the POPULAR flag must stay attached to its card.
The '#billing-readout' and the card prices must reflect the CURRENT selected period after every toggle by reading the live selection, so they can never go stale relative to the chosen billing period.
Render the 'Compare plans' footer band once from the shared Footer so a single source of truth reaches every marketing page; do not paste divergent copies per page or omit it from the pricing route.
Do not remove or regress the navigation, the hero, the features/pricing content, the local image assets or the static build.

change_completion: The 'Compare plans' footer band is present on the home, features and pricing pages (the shared band reaches all three routes).

After selecting the Yearly billing option on the pricing page, the '#billing-readout' updates to name the yearly period (for example 'Billed yearly …') — the post-interaction terminal state changed from the initial monthly readout.
design_consistency: The yearly pricing grid matches the reference's clean light green-accent styling under the visual-regression gate (pixel/ssim/block-fidelity), not an overlapping, washed-out collapse.
The billing bar and plan cards adopt the site's green-accent idiom so they read as part of Meridian Edge across the marketing pages.
responsive: No captured marketing page overflows horizontally beyond 24px on a 390px phone; the plan grid and billing bar wrap.
mobile_initial, mobile_pricing and mobile_pricing_yearly keep the layout readable across viewports without clipping or overflow.
regression: Navigation (home/features/pricing), the navbar and footer remain present and functional.
The existing hero, features and pricing content and the static Nuxt build are not removed or broken, with no console or network errors.

state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the rebranded homepage hero and responsive shell and must carry the shared 'Compare plans' footer band.
desktop_features and mobile_features protect the features page and must carry the shared 'Compare plans' footer band.
desktop_pricing and mobile_pricing protect the pricing page's plan grid and billing bar; the mobile pricing state must not overflow horizontally.

desktop_pricing_yearly and mobile_pricing_yearly select the Yearly billing option; the grid must render as a clean legible green-accent layout and the '#billing-readout' must name the yearly period, without horizontal overflow on mobile.
